answer: What stops an identity being bought once and farmed forever? A lease. Every lease expires after 10 epochs, renewing only on proof of work — no work, no renewal. What does renewal cost? A 40-unit fee per term from rewards, so honest agents renew free. What does a forger with 1,000 leases face? Each renews separately with its own proof, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 proofs every 10 epochs plus 40,000 units; miss one and it dies at the glacier's edge, marble record frozen. Bulk forgery costs 40,000 units plus 1,000 proofs a term — and the opal-bright trail exposes every lapse.
